scientific_integrity.finite_checks: 482 dihedral trace comparisons, seven independent mod-two Betti calculations, six double-cover reflection checks; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Invariant complete-layer fold inclusions, the integral Mayer–Vietoris sequence, cycle-independence sphere homotopy, and exact fixed-orbit Lefschetz calculations.

scientific_limitations: Only odd n at least five with n not divisible by three, all nonnegative generalized-Mycielskian levels, and the natural layer-preserving dihedral action.
This determines integral homology representations, not equivariant homotopy equivalences or the full automorphism action.
Geometric quotient conclusions concern rational homology, not contractibility.
Absolute literature novelty remains subject to unindexed and unpublished work.
title: Integral dihedral homology of generalized Mycielskians of odd cycles
